job.job_description:
Role Overview

As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems powered by Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks. You will work on production-grade AI applications that serve millions of customers and help shape the next generation of digital experiences across Deutsche Telekom's ecosystem.




Key Skills

Python
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain
LangGraph
Agentic AI Frameworks
Prompt Engineering
API Development
Cloud Technologies



What You'll Do

Build production-ready AI applications
Develop multi-agent workflows and orchestration systems
Implement RAG pipelines and knowledge systems
Integrate LLMs into customer-facing products
Optimize AI performance, reliability, and scalability
Collaborate with product, platform, and engineering teams
